about: Mina, the Noita witch, as a Magicraft starting set (Magicraft's character pick in the camp). Her look comes from the player's Noita install (data/enemies_gfx/player.png + player.xml); her wands use Noita wand sprites and start loaded with Noita spells from spells.json.

columns.setId: Magicraft SetConfig id; must be 13 (UISet picks a set by index+1, Magicraft ships 1..12)
columns.name: shown name (Mina is not named in Noita's own text)
columns.wandIds: wands.json rows, one per set upgrade level
columns.spriteXml: Noita sprite definition read for her look
columns.worldHeight: her height in Magicraft world units
columns.uiHeight: her height in pixels on the set-picker card

rows.name: Mina
rows.description: The Noita witch. Starts with Noita wands; Noita spells join the loot.

columns.wandId: new Magicraft WandConfig id (not in Magicraft)
columns.cloneOf: Magicraft wand whose stats are cloned
columns.nameKey: Noita translation key for the wand's name
columns.icon: Noita sprite used as the wand icon and in Mina's hand, laid along the diagonal of a canvas like Magicraft's own wand sprite (Magicraft turns that diagonal toward the aim)
columns.slots: starting spells, left to right (spells.json newBase*10+1, or 0 for empty)
